content: I only got 2 M3x8rT screws in the bag (despite it saying 2+1spare). One of them was incorrectly manufactured and its thread is stripped. So I used regular M3x10 which I have plenty after all these upgrades done in the past. Worst case you will need to reprint that part - zip tie works as temp solution too.
The clip was tilting/slipping but snapped in place when pushed harder
I found it easy to align by inserting the end of the nylon into the hole, while sliding on the clip.
